host.qemu:
QEMU emulator version 10.2.1 (Debian 1:10.2.1+ds-1ubuntu3.2)
Copyright (c) 2003-2025 Fabrice Bellard and the QEMU Project developers

drm_memory.scope: Test UID DRM client counters; duplicate handles counted once. Shared buffers across distinct clients may be counted more than once. Unsupported or incomplete samples are not zero.

presentation_cadence.scope: Native SHM xdg-toplevel with alternating damage, paced by wl_surface.frame. wp_presentation timestamps measure this client's presentation cadence, not compositor input-to-frame tracing. Hardware flags and unknown refresh are explicit.

limitations: QMP observations are bounded host-visible response times, not compositor input-to-frame tracing.
CPU counts surviving sampled processes; exited processes can consume unobserved CPU.
PSS covers the test UID and excludes the observer and its descendants; root/GDM shared services are outside this scope.
Whole-run summaries include startup and workload. Idle CPU uses guest-clock markers and only intervals wholly within the idle phase.
DRM memory is optional driver-provided client accounting, not unique physical GPU allocation; unavailable samples are explicit.

Notification IDs prove service acceptance, not notification input-to-frame latency. Presentation cadence is a native client workload; compositor input tracing, multiple cold/warm boots and 24-hour soak remain open.
No release threshold or claim of within-10-percent parity is introduced.
